title: SPARK: Adaptive Parametric Knowledge Participation for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2606.27786v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances the faithfulness of large language models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge into the generation process. However, conflicts between retrieved context and parametric knowledge can cause LLMs to rely on inconsistent internal knowledge, hindering their ability to faithfully leverage retrieved evidence. Existing approaches mitigate this issue by editing parametric knowledge to resolve such conflicts. However, locating and modifying knowledge encoded in model parameters is challenging and may inadvertently compromise the backbone LLM's capabilities. translated_title: SPARK：面向忠实检索增强生成的自适应参数化知识参与
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将外部知识融入生成过程来增强大型语言模型（LLM）的忠实性。然而，检索到的上下文与参数化知识之间的冲突可能导致LLM依赖不一致的内部知识，阻碍其忠实利用检索证据的能力。现有方法通过编辑参数化知识来缓解这一问题，以解决此类冲突。然而，定位和修改编码在模型参数中的知识十分困难，并且可能无意中损害骨干LLM的能力。在本文中，我们提出了SPARK，这是一个新颖的框架，它将参数化知识控制形式化为潜在参与策略学习问题，使LLM能够在生成过程中自适应地调节参数化知识的贡献。具体而言，SPARK引入了一个轻量级的参与策略，动态调制……
tldr: SPARK框架将参数化知识控制形式化为潜在参与策略学习问题，通过轻量级参与策略动态调节生成过程中参数化知识的贡献，从而解决RAG中检索上下文与模型内部知识的冲突，提升生成忠实性，同时避免直接编辑模型参数可能带来的能力损害。
en_tdlr: SPARK formulates parametric knowledge control as a latent participation policy learning problem, using a lightweight participation policy to adaptively regulate the contribution of parametric knowledge during generation, thereby resolving conflicts between retrieved context and internal knowledge in RAG to improve faithfulness without compromising the backbone LLM's capabilities.
